title: English for Technical Job Performance
overview: English for Technical Job Performance is a practical, workplace-oriented language program designed to help technical employees communicate accurately, confidently and safely in English. Across three months, participants strengthen the language used to interpret technical instructions, explain equipment and processes, report faults, coordinate maintenance, document work, and interact with colleagues, supervisors, contractors and customers. The course integrates listening, speaking, reading and writing with authentic technical scenarios, while adapting terminology and tasks to participants’ industries and job roles.
audience: Technicians, engineers, maintenance staff, operators and technical supervisors.
Employees in manufacturing, construction, utilities, facilities, logistics, IT support and related technical functions.
Technical staff who use English in shift handovers, safety briefings, service calls, reporting or contractor coordination.
Professionals seeking to improve job-specific English accuracy, fluency and confidence.
methodology: A communicative, task-based approach combining instructor-led language input with technical workplace simulations, paired dialogues, pronunciation drills, listening activities, guided reading, structured writing, role-plays and practical assessments. Participants work with sample manuals, job cards, checklists, diagrams, incident descriptions and handover notes. Diagnostic assessment, continuous feedback, targeted vocabulary practice and a final integrated performance task support measurable improvement.
competencies: Technical vocabulary and accurate workplace terminology.
Listening comprehension of technical instructions and operational discussions.
Clear spoken explanations, questioning and clarification.
Reading and interpretation of technical documents and visual information.
Concise, accurate technical writing and reporting.
Safety-critical communication and effective shift handovers.
Professional collaboration, troubleshooting discussions and customer interaction.
objectives: Use appropriate English to describe tools, materials, components, equipment and technical operations.
Understand and confirm spoken instructions, warnings, procedures and work priorities.
Read manuals, specifications, diagrams, work orders and safety information for key details.
Explain processes, operating conditions, faults and corrective actions in clear sequences.
Participate effectively in technical meetings, briefings, handovers and troubleshooting discussions.
Write accurate emails, maintenance notes, service updates, incident descriptions and concise reports.
Apply clarification, confirmation and escalation language to reduce communication errors.
Demonstrate improved technical English through realistic workplace performance tasks.
